about: Typing rules of the file editor, read by editorTyping.test.ts (CodeMirror) and crates/perch-native/tests/editor_typing.rs (the native editor). `doc`: the text with the caret at `|`, or a selection between `[` and `]`. `keys`: typed in order; a one-character string is typed, `enter`, `backspace` and `undo` are those keys. `expect`: the text afterwards, the caret or selection marked the same way. `web`: false for a case CodeMirror's commands in the web test cannot drive (the web editor gets it from its keymap).
